pll_bitfield.register: 0x03001040 (video PLL, as named in the same-boot readback report)

bits[0].meaning: not read by calc_rate_video0 for this PLL

bit27.meaning: not read by calc_rate_video0; it is one of the three bits the hardware adds on top of the table word, and the factors descriptor declares bit index 27 at +0x0f, so a status/lock role is likely but still unproven

bit31.meaning: PLL enable is the conventional bit for this CCU generation, but the enable field lives in the per-clock factors descriptor whose pointer fields are zero in this ELF, so it is not binary-confirmed

pll_bitfield.consistency: matches the measured pll_video0x4 / tcon_lcd = 288 MHz in the same boot
pll_bitfield.open_discrepancy: WITHDRAWN in addendum.pll_table_consistency: factor_pllvideo0x4_tbl is fully consistent with calc_rate_video0 (0x1702 -> 288 MHz). The 2x claim was a mis-read.
pll_bitfield.live_word_arithmetic: the live word equals the table entry for 288 MHz plus exactly three bits: 0x88001703 - 0x00001702 = 0x88000001 = bit31 | bit27 | bit0

divider_encoding.writer_semantics: val = readl(base+0x44); bfxil val, div, #0, #7; writel(val, base+0x44)
divider_encoding.field: bits[6:0] = 11, written verbatim: no minus-one, no plus-one, no log2 encoding anywhere in the writer or its caller
divider_encoding.upper_bits: bits[31:28] = 0xf are written by tcon0_open (orr 0xf0000000), not preserved incidentally; see addendum.tcon_register_44

where_11_comes_from.override_that_yields_11: for lcd_if index 0, if panel_info.lcd_dclk_freq == 0x1a (26 MHz) the divider is forced to 0x0b = 11: 'cmp w0,#0x1a; mov w0,#0xb; csel w1, w1, w0, ne'. Other frequencies keep the table value. The baseline DT declares exactly 26, so 11 applies.
where_11_comes_from.consequence: the divider is still a compile-time constant, not a function of the pixel clock: lcd_dclk_freq only selects the 26 MHz special case. It does nevertheless feed a later clock-rate calculation - see addendum.clock.rate_math.

divider_encoding.superseded_note: numeric result (11) and the bfxil write are CONFIRMED. Three mechanism labels are corrected: the index field is lcd_if (not lcd_type); 0x80 is lcd_dclk_freq (not a SoC/version word); and the csel condition is NE, i.e. divider becomes 0xb when lcd_dclk_freq == 26, not when it differs from 26.

panel_name_table.note: CORRECTED in addendum.panel_lifecycle: 0x8ffc580 is the inline .name of a 0x60-stride panel struct; the driver table is the pointer array at 0x8ffbef0 (17 entries); the symbol of this entry is fog_fj035fhd05_v1_panel.
